title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

July 10, 2025

By Electronic Filing

Hon. Scott Harris, Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, D.C. 20543

Re: Gabriel Olivier v. City of Brandon, et al., No. 24-993
Dear Mr. Harris:
On July 3, 2025, the Court granted the above petition.  Under the Court’s rules, the
petitioner’s brief and joint appendix are currently due on August 18, 2025, and
respondents’ brief is due on September 17, 2025.
Because of scheduling conflicts created by ongoing litigation matters, both parties
request an extension of time to file petitioner’s opening merits brief and joint
appendix, and an extension of time to file respondents’ merits brief.
Pursuant to Rule 30.4 of the Rules of this  Court and subject to the Court’s approval,
the parties propose the following briefing schedule:
Petitioner’s brief and joint appendix: September 2, 2025
Respondents’ brief: October 16, 2025
Respectfully submitted,

/s/ Allyson N. Ho
Allyson N. Ho

Counsel of Record for Petitioner


cc: Gregory Todd Butler, Counsel for Respondents
